import mmap
from freetoken.moe.offload_cache import OffloadMoeCache
from freetoken.layers import moe

    moe._PREFILL_HOT_OVERLAP = bool(int.from_bytes(_control[:8], 'little'))

OffloadMoeCache.begin_prefill = _begin
""")
